UDAYA KUMAR H

Senior Java Full Stack Developer

✉ udaykh4@gmail.com | +91-8105409848 | Udaya Kumar Hosur | LinkedIn

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Versatile Java Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience in backend development, system design, and micro services architecture across domains such as finance and enterprise SaaS. Known for solving complex technical challenges, mentoring teams, and delivering scalable, high-performance solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and Micro services.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: Java 11, SQL, JSON, XML

Backend: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate, J2EE (Servlets, JSP, JSF), Multithreading

Frontend (Basic experience): JavaScript, HTML, CSS, AJAX

Web Services: REST, SOAP, Microservices

Event-Driven Architecture: Kafka, CDC using MongoDB Change Streams, Event Listeners

Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, Oracle, IBM DB2, H2

Testing: JUnit, Mockito, Power Mock

Cloud Platforms: AWS (S3), GCP, IBM Private Cloud.

DevOps & Tools: Jenkins, Maven, Git, IntelliJ, Eclipse, Postman, SoapUI, JIRA, Splunk, Dynatrace, Fiddler

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

TEKsystems (Client: Adobe) – Senior Java Consultant	October 2023 – Present

Designed and implemented scalable and high-performance REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.

Designed and implemented resilient microservices-based systems with event-driven architecture.

Optimized backend services and data access layers, reducing API response times by 40%.

Mentored junior developers, led technical discussions, championed clean code practices.

Participated in architectural planning and tech evaluations for new services and integrations.

A prompt based project generate works with Azure AI services to create end to end project which Just runs. It creates both UI and Backend with all CURD operations.

WIPRO (Client: Lloyds Bank Group UK) – Technologist	April 2017 – October 2023

Developed and maintained scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.

Data modeling and schema design for services interacting with relational and SQL databases.

Migrated legacy monolithic services to microservices architecture, using RESTful APIs.

Enhanced reliability through implemented structured logging, monitoring, and alerting (Splunk, Dynatrace).

REVATURE – Software Engineer	July 2014 – March 2017

Developed Restful APIs for a Retail management platform.

Converted business requirements into modular, reusable backend components.

Played a key role in migrating MySQL applications to enterprise applications

EDUCATION

MCA| SV University | 2009–2012

CERTIFICATIONS

Oracle Certified Associate Java Programmer (OCAJP 1.8) – Oracle, 2023

Associate Cloud Engineer – Google Cloud, 2022
